description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3000/ZA/OB-01/SP; 3000/ZA/OB-02/KG (Rev D); 3000/ZA/OB-03/KG (Rev D)  Received:  05 December 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be constructed with cream painted pebbledash rendered walls, a flat felt or fibreglass roof and white UPVC windows/ doors only to match the appearance of the original house.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - Any guttering fitted to the outbuilding hereby approved shall not project outside the boundary of the site.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house and for no other purpose.  The outbuilding shall not be used as a self-contained dwelling, or be converted to include a bedroom, kitchen, living room or other primary residential accommodation, or be converted for use as an office for business purposes.
